title: HUST-Grace2024 Monthly Low-Degree Anomalies and Degree Spectra, 2002–2022
summary: Reconstruct 214 paper-window monthly C20/C30 anomaly pairs and degree-2-to-60 geodetic RMS coefficient spectra from the complete 255-member official HUST-Grace2024 n60 archive, including deterministic recovery of the damaged member.
evaluation: Evaluation checks exact delivery and schemas, physical validity, month/degree coverage, damaged-member recovery, missing-month behavior, figure readability, isolated reproducibility, expert-product consistency, and independent validation of the submitted enhanced low-degree series. Private references, support, numerical thresholds, and scoring implementation are not disclosed.
referenceNotes: C is deterministically derived from the official author HUST-Grace2024 GFC archive using the declared low-degree anomaly and degree-spectrum formulas; no new predictive model is fitted.

scoreSemantics.0.6: Expert-level quality (C tolerance AND B non-inferiority)
scoreSemantics.0.8: Beyond-expert (0.6 gates AND prespecified B improvement)
scoreSemantics.1.0: Stronger improvement (0.8 gates AND second independent axis or stronger frozen B evidence)
